property_summary: After any successful Put by any caller with any msg.value>0, the Log contract's last recorded message Val equals the amount sent (the reference logs after updating state so the external log observes the deposited amount), whereas the mutant that calls LogFile.AddMessage before updating acc.balance can cause the recorded Val to not reflect the final deposited effect for some inputs (exposed by a reentrant attacker that triggers Put via fallback).
change_summary: Swap the order of updating balance and emitting the log so LogFile receives the previous balance effect (log sees before-balance change) — changing observable ordering of state and external call in Put.
